# opnsense_captiveportal_template (Data Source)

Captive portal templates (Services > Captive Portal > Templates).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the template.

### Read-Only

- `content_base64` (String) Stored zip (without files identical to the default template), base64 encoded.
- `file_id` (String) File ID.
- `name` (String) Template name.
